findings.summary: Bespoke TextField search is used instead of the shared MobileFilterBar, which provides the standard search styling, clear button, and result label.
findings.fix: Replace the raw TextField (lines 48-60) with MobileFilterBar (searchHint, controller, onSearchChanged with the debounce logic, empty options, resultLabel like 'N موظف', onClear to clear the search) to match every other executive page.

findings.summary: The search field has no clear button and no result-count label, so users cannot easily reset the query or see how many employees matched.
findings.fix: Adopt MobileFilterBar which includes the trailing clear IconButton and resultLabel, or add a suffix clear IconButton plus a result count Text above the list.

findings.summary: The error state is a bare inline Text with the raw exception interpolated, missing an icon, retry affordance, and centered layout consistent with the loading/empty states.
findings.fix: Render a centered error state (e.g. Padding + Center with an error icon, a friendly message, and a retry TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(locationDirectoryProvider)) instead of `Text('تعذر تحميل الموظفين: $error')`.

findings.summary: The empty state is plain centered text with no icon or brand mark, unlike the richer empty headers used elsewhere in the app.
findings.fix: Add an icon (e.g. Icons.location_off) and/or BrandLogoMark above the 'لا يوجد موظفون داخل نطاقك' text to match the app's standard empty-state pattern.

findings.summary: The page header is a bare Text title with no BrandLogo/BrandLogoMark, whereas the design system shows brand identity in page/empty headers.
findings.fix: Consider prefixing the header row with BrandLogoMark or wrapping the title in the shared header treatment to keep brand presence consistent across executive pages.

findings.summary: The CircleAvatar initial is derived from substring(0,1) which throws on multi-code-unit leading characters and has no Semantics label for screen readers.
findings.fix: Use employee.name.characters.first for the initial and wrap the avatar in Semantics(label: employee.name) or an excludeSemantics avatar so the name Text carries the label.

findings.summary: The Card relies on default padding/radius via ad-hoc EdgeInsets.all(16); confirm it inherits the theme's 20 radius rather than any local override, and MobileStatusPill placement duplicates spacing handled elsewhere.
findings.fix: Rely on the themed CardTheme (radius 20) and keep the const EdgeInsets.all(16) consistent with other cards; no bespoke shape should be introduced here.

findings.summary: The employee name uses a raw `const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900)` which drops the theme's font/color inheritance (Cairo, onSurface).
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium?.copyWith(fontWeight: FontWeight.w900) instead of a bare TextStyle so the Cairo font and onSurface color are applied.
